scenes.heading: why components
scenes.caption: Components are the reusable pieces of a React interface. Each one is a function from props to elements. The screen is a tree of them. Data flows down the tree. Events flow up, or into shared state.

scenes.heading: Props
scenes.caption: Props are the inputs a component receives from its parent. In a function component they arrive as the first argument. The child should treat them as read-only. They are how you reuse one component with different data. Changing a prop means the parent renders again with a new value. The child does not assign to props.
